# `!` — Factorial / Binomial

`!Y`: Y!. Pervasive.

```apl
!5                ⍝ 120
!5x               ⍝ 120ₓ
```

`X!Y`: binomial coefficient, Y choose X. Pervasive.

```apl
2!5               ⍝ 10
2x!5x             ⍝ 10ₓ
```

Extends through Gamma to non-integral and complex arguments.

## Errors

- `DOMAIN`: factorial poles
